name: TOB Reading Plan Day
description: One day's reading within a TOB Reading Plan. A top-level doctype (not a child table) so an admin can add/edit/reorder days independently via generic REST, same pattern as TOB Notification Template/TOB Encouragement Message. book_id follows the app's own fixed 1-66 canonical book numbering (Genesis=1 ... Revelation=66, see bible_books_screen.dart) so the Flutter client can deep-link straight into ReadChapterPage.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: e.g. "Creation Begins" — a short, inviting label for the day, not just the reference.

fields.label: Book ID
fields.description: 1-66, matching the app's fixed canonical book order (Genesis=1 ... Revelation=66).

fields.label: Chapter (end)
fields.description: Leave blank for a single-chapter reading. When set, the day spans chapter_start through chapter_end (the app still deep-links to chapter_start; the range is shown as text).

fields.label: Reference Label
fields.description: The human-readable reference shown on the card, e.g. "Genesis 1-2" or "Psalm 23".

fields.label: Note
fields.description: A short, age-appropriate reflection or context line shown under the reading.
